description: Web page to PDF. Send a public URL; returns the page's main content as a clean A4 PDF (base64 in JSON), text and tables only, without navigation or ads. Use to archive or share an article. No JavaScript rendering, images or pages behind logins. Social networks (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok and similar) are refused. Typical response under 3 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).
